findings.what: Rule conflict on the CI '?' branch. W2 TABLE v4 (2)(iv) ('CI ? and BASE in {exp78a, exp78b} -> that BASE + CI stack') and W4 AMEND 2 (1) item 2 ('one file per ? lever on BASE') would submit a CI stack for ANY CI '?'. That includes the cases the earlier rules forbid. (1) The CI-RAN GATE NO-OP (dL <= 0.5 h): 'never licenses a CI resubmit; CI then goes to the post-deadline list as untested'. (2) R21-A3 (d): exp79a ERROR at > 10 h means no CI stack. (3) 'v' (L_hi > 10.2 h): a cap-12/cap-8 CI stack carries the same late-runtime risk, with only ~1.25 h of margin to 12 h. Codes v2 (2) define '? = MASKED, BLIND, v or ERR', so the conflict is literal. Read literally, the 12:00Z W2b slot would go to exp83a/exp83b in exactly the worlds where CI is known not to run, or runs too late.
